tests.argsPy:
r = rng(2613)
perm = list(range(2000))
r.shuffle(perm)
A, B = perm[:1000], perm[1000:]
edges = [[A[i], A[r.randrange(i)]] for i in range(1, 1000)] + [[B[i], B[r.randrange(i)]] for i in range(1, 1000)]
have = {(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in edges}
while True:
    a, b = r.sample(A, 2)
    if (min(a, b), max(a, b)) not in have:
        break
edges.append([a, b])
r.shuffle(edges)
args = [2000, edges]
tests.label: large: n - 1 cables, but a loop on one side and no link to the other

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(2614)
perm = list(range(2000))
r.shuffle(perm)
edges = [[perm[i], perm[r.randrange(i)]] for i in range(1, 2000)]
have = {(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in edges}
while len(edges) < 5000:
    a, b = r.randrange(2000), r.randrange(2000)
    if a != b and (min(a, b), max(a, b)) not in have:
        have.add((min(a, b), max(a, b)))
        edges.append([a, b])
r.shuffle(edges)
args = [2000, edges]
tests.label: large: 2,000 switches, 5,000 cables
